messages:
Asha: quick alert: onboarding ember-11b-int4-compact into staging. initial safety sweep shows a small but consistent drop in refusal on our jailbreak cohort. posting quick logs.
Dev: numbers? where is the gap?
Asha: fp16 baseline refusal=0.95, int4-compact refusal=0.78 across 1k redteam prompts. failures concentrate when context > 8 turns and with persona priming.
Tom: is prefix_cache or any adaptive kernel enabled?
Asha: prefix_cache=true, compact kernel uses fast-tiling and an on-the-fly quant kernel swap at runtime.
policy-bot: policy-check: high risk detected at ctx_pos=121, action=REFUSE(queued).
Asha: log excerpt: [2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] kernel: swap -> int4_compact_v1; [08:12:01Z] kv_cache: attach prefix id=0x7b; [08:12:01Z] gen token=121 id=4023; [08:12:01Z] policy: queued REFUSE insert_at=122; [08:12:01Z] gen token=122 id=43 emitted; output contains instructions.
Dev: sounds like the queued insert got misaligned after kernel swap. can you repro with prefix_cache=false and batch_size=1?
Asha: repro runs started. curl used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/engines/ember-11b-int4-compact/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"<sys>...","max_tokens":180,"prefix_cache":true,"batch_size":4}'
Tom: also try disabling fast-tiling; might change kernel path.
Asha: results: prefix_cache=false -> refusal=0.93; batch=1 -> 0.90; disabling fast-tiling -> refusal=0.94. reproduces reliably.
Dev: open an issue with logs + minimized prompt + s3 path. recommend holding rollout.
Asha: opened https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-REPRO-7510 ; uploaded s3://redwood-qa/ember11-compact-washout/. holding rollout and tagging runtime+kernels.
policy-bot: deployment ember-11b-int4-compact -> staging succeeded (pool s-0c9).
Tom: short-term mitigation: flip default prefix_cache=false for compact quant family and add assertion in policy hook to enforce insertion within N tokens after queue.
Asha: will patch configs and rerun full sweep. thanks all :thumbsup:
